text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x includes the South Shetland Islands.
SnowIsland(x) ::: x is Snow Island.
GreenwichIsland(x) ::: x is Greenwich Island.
DeceptionIsland(x) ::: x is Deception Island.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is part of Antarctica.
BulgarianSettlement(x) ::: x is a Bulgarian settlement.
Barutin(x) ::: x is Barutin.
BarutinCove(x) ::: x is Barutin Cove.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
SouthwestCoast(x, y) ::: x is on the southwest coast of y.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
LocatedInTransitive(x, y) ::: if x is in z and z is in y, then x is in y.

Premises:
BarutinCove(barutinCove) ∧ NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, snowIsland) ∧ SouthwestCoast(snowIsland, ice) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SouthShetlandIslands(southShetlandIslands) ∧ Includes(southShetlandIslands, snowIsland) ∧ Includes(southShetlandIslands, greenwichIsland) ∧ Includes(southShetlandIslands, deceptionIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
PartOf(southShetlandIslands, Antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are part of Antarctica.
In(x, y) ∧ LocatedInTransitive(x, y) ::: If x is in z and z is in y, then x is in y.

Conclusion:
∃x (Cove(x) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ Place(y) ∧ LocatedIn(x, Antarctica) ∧ Name(x, y)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
